partitions: each width uses row/column offsets 0 and half-width relative to the declared LAEA viewer lattice
score_policy: retain original cohort score values, re-rank scores and both outcomes within each retained identical cohort
scope: sampled observed-date record novelty, not future ecological discovery or equal field hours
range_policy: report all deletion ranges; no partition selection, confidence intervals or calibrated probabilities

sources.citation_scope: motivating limitations, not a claim that these sources validate this descriptive deletion diagnostic

cohorts.reference_verified: input/frame/grid/source hashes, cell counts, outcome means and both named full/paired score correlations

limitations.identifications: research-grade IDs at the later pull, not a historical ID snapshot
limitations.inventory: later published footprint, not a historical footprint snapshot
limitations.record_scope: page-capped project sample, not the complete cell inventory
limitations.exchangeability: unrestricted cell permutations assume exchangeability, not established
limitations.inference: retrospective association, not a prospective or causal trip-yield estimate

sensitivity.estimand: change in within-cohort Spearman correlation after standardizing sampled training history
sensitivity.interpretation: location-dominance diagnostic, not a confidence interval or dependence-corrected test
